nice-c-te-d-azur-col-de-turini-morning-a.story: Scenery first, traffic last, with checkpoints that make sense on a bike. A 299 km loop that starts and ends near Olivetta San Michele, about 5 h 26 of riding. It goes by way of Saint-Étienne-de-Tinée, near Seillans and Saint-Laurent-du-Var. The climbs: Théoule-sur-Mer, Cap-d'Ail and Ospedaletti. It tops out at about 1,950 m. It crosses Italy, France and Monaco - carry ID and check vignette or toll rules. Long stretches are under trees.

Las Cabritas → Diosa madre is 23 km of rhythm rather than effort. Let it flow and let the view breathe.
Diosa madre → back through Las Cabritas is 23 km of rhythm rather than effort. Let it flow and let the view breathe.
back through Las Cabritas → Cañaica del Calar lI is 15 km of rhythm rather than effort. Let it flow and let the view breathe.

places-canaica-del-calar-li-diosa-madre.story: A 83 km round trip from Nerpio - roughly 1 h 26 in the saddle. On the way it passes Las Cabritas, Diosa madre and back through Las Cabritas. The highest point is about 1,400 m. The line favours views over speed.
